description.ko: 하나의 컴파일러 바이너리로 통합 검사가 끝난 시점을 보존한다. 이후 작업 트리 변경의 검증을 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: Preserve one coherent compiler/test checkpoint without certifying later working-tree changes.

binary.execution_scope: Local host execution; not proof of every target platform.

source_snapshot.working_tree: Includes uncommitted development changes. Git HEAD alone is not the tested source snapshot.
source_snapshot.identity_boundary: Compiler/runtime/library executable source stayed frozen throughout the suite. The recorded manifest additionally contains unregistered floating preview tests and documentation tooling; only those two files changed (new preview fixture preparation and one render-only prose paragraph). Current documentation tooling tests passed separately. Future floating APIs are excluded from this checkpoint.

ctest.note: The immutable local checkpoint copy is ignored build evidence; its recorded hash identifies the completed 120-test run. Later targeted tests may replace the ordinary temporary CTest log.

task_owned.scope: Owned-only captures/results, one native thread per admitted child, retained Scope observation loans and explicit/retrying drain. Borrowed workers, nested scopes, pools, composition, detach and remaining synchronous catalog APIs are not implemented by this subset.

task_resources.scope: File ownership/worker IO/Drop plus monotonic time and blocking sleep. This is not async suspension.

thread_safety.scope: Sealed derived Send/Sync, transitive effects and cleanup, narrow audited IO admission.

bytes.scope: Explicit-endian codecs through128bit and four float formats, bit helpers, strict textual codecs, overlap-safe copy with prevalidated bounds and allocation-failure cleanup. Compact row fingerprints in scalar exhaustive models remain probabilistic; direct exact assertions are separate.

float_bits.scope: Exact f16/bf16/f32/f64 raw representation and closed numeric-conversion verifier, not future floating source utilities.

range.scope: Seven descriptor inspection operations and preserved source bounds after iteration.

selected_gates.ordered: The complete registered ordered source gate passed on this binary in376.52seconds; complete catalog iterator coverage remains a separate obligation.

browser_check.cleanup: English restored; temporary tab and localhost server closed.
browser_check.boundary: Layout and language switching were checked before the checkpoint label rerender; the new label itself is generated afterward.

excluded_future_work: The complete synchronous CPU catalog remains incomplete; declaration presence and passing registered gates do not prove every contract.
Borrowed Task/Scope roots, asynchronous reference stores and borrowed results remain rejected until independent ownership proofs are implemented.
The next five Task conveniences and floating source module are not part of this checkpoint.
GPU-only operations/Pending remain deferred; suspending Task/async APIs target0.4.
This local macOS ARM64 run does not establish latest-source Linux or Windows execution.
Performance-changing optimization remains held pending absent final Claude advice.
